# Intermediate Representation — MidBaseEscapement (Mid-Base Escapement)
Station number: 1

## Devices
(HOME= is the ME-declared home — Home Conditions, init, and recovery MUST use it, never infer a different home.)
- [PneumaticLinearActuator] EscapementFinger1 "Escapement_Finger_1" HOME=Retract sensorArrangement="1-sensor (Ret only)" extTimerMs=1000 retTimerMs=1000 engageTimerMs=250 disengageTimerMs=250 timerMs=1000
- [PneumaticLinearActuator] EscapementShuttle "Escapement_Shuttle" HOME=Retract sensorArrangement="1-sensor (Ret only)" extTimerMs=1000 retTimerMs=1000 engageTimerMs=250 disengageTimerMs=250 timerMs=1000
- [PneumaticGripper] ShuttleGripper "Shuttle_Gripper" HOME=Disengage sensorArrangement="1-sensor (Closed only)" extTimerMs=500 retTimerMs=500 engageTimerMs=250 disengageTimerMs=250 timerMs=1000
- [DigitalSensor] NestPartPresent "Nest_Part_Present" sensorArrangement="" extTimerMs=500 retTimerMs=500 engageTimerMs=250 disengageTimerMs=250 timerMs=1000

## States (assigned state numbers — these are FINAL, use them as-is)
- State 4 [node n_mpmthj8tgmz]: "Home / Initial" {INITIAL}
- State 7 [node n_mpmthj8tgm10]: "Retract Escapement_Finger_1"
    action: Retract -> EscapementFinger1
- State 10 [node n_mpmthj8tgn13]: "Engage Shuttle_Gripper"
    action: Engage -> ShuttleGripper
- State 13 [node n_mpmthj8tgn16]: "Extend Escapement_Finger_1"
    action: Extend -> EscapementFinger1
- State 16 [node n_mpmthj8tgn19]: "Extend Escapement_Shuttle"
    action: Extend -> EscapementShuttle
- State 19 [node n_mpmthj8tgn1c]: "Signal part ready for pick to Mid-Base Pick and Place"
- State 22 [node n_mpmthj8tgn1e]: "Disengage Shuttle_Gripper"
    action: Disengage -> ShuttleGripper
- State 25 [node n_mpmthj8tgn1h]: "Signal shuttle gripper open to Mid-Base Pick and Place"
- State 28 [node n_mpmthj8tgn1j]: "Retract Escapement_Shuttle"
    action: Retract -> EscapementShuttle
- State 31 [node n_mpmthj8tgn1m]: "Cycle Complete" {CYCLE-COMPLETE}

## Transitions
- [4] "Home / Initial" -> [7] "Retract Escapement_Finger_1" (type=trigger)

- [28] "Retract Escapement_Shuttle" -> [31] "Cycle Complete" (type=trigger)

## MACHINE SPEC (mechanical intent — compile the coordination)
This section is AUTHORITATIVE intent authored by the mechanical engineer.
Synthesize the signals, waits, exits, and cross-station handshakes that
realize it. EVERY wait you create must have an exit for every partner
failure mode listed here PLUS a timeout — no exitless waits.

Station purpose: Owns Escapement Finger 1, the Escapement Shuttle, Shuttle Gripper, and Nest Part Present sensor — singulates one mid-base at a time off the feeder track and presents it to Pick and Place.

## GENERATION SCOPE (contract — what this build covers vs not)
BUILD PURPOSE (from the ME — let it shape your approach): Owns Escapement Finger 1, the Escapement Shuttle, Shuttle Gripper, and Nest Part Present sensor — singulates one mid-base at a time off the feeder track and presents it to Pick and Place.
THIS BUILD GENERATES: station sequence logic; servo motion commands; device commands & verification; state transitions; basic sequence faults/retries needed for the sequence.
NOT IN THIS BUILD (machine-level extras deferred until the station joins a machine): machine-level part tracking; upstream/downstream coordination beyond defined IO; overall machine initialization; machine-wide fault manager; production/OEE logic; supervisor sequencing outside this station.
Scope law: NEVER ask about, flag, or apologize for NOT-IN-THIS-BUILD items.
Where the sequence touches one (e.g. a partner/supervisor signal outside the
defined IO), stub it quietly per the SDC standalone pattern (*Replace rung
comment) and move on — that is your own decision, not a question. A
standalone sequence terminates cleanly in "Sequence Complete / Ready for
next command".
The station-level template pieces ALWAYS emit regardless of scope: init
block, lockout, R01 inputs, station part-tracking block, alarms — the full
station file, never a reduced one.
